title: Spicy Ukrainian Pork Skewers
description: Deliciously marinated pork skewers with a spicy twist, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the pork into consistent sizes for even cooking.

ingredients.name: Spicy Ukrainian seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: You can make your own blend by mixing together paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.

ingredients.name: Roasted red peppers, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use jarred roasted peppers if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Red onion, sliced
ingredients.notes: Make sure to slice the onion thinly for even cooking.

ingredients.name: Spicy peppers, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use jalapeños or other spicy peppers of your choice.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Make sure to soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before using to prevent them from catching fire during cooking.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, lime juice, spicy Ukrainian seasoning blend, and honey.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated pork, roasted red peppers, red onion, cilantro, and spicy peppers onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional cilantro and spicy peppers if desired.
Make sure to let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
